verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's core design (columnar MergeTree, materialized views to precompute aggregations, parallelized inserts/queries) is built for fast analytical aggregation directly on the OLTP-adjacent store, and community reports corroborate real-time aggregation over hundreds of millions to billions of rows with sub-minute/second latency suitable for dashboards, avoiding a separate warehouse. missing for 10: no first-party published dashboard-benchmark numbers in the pack, and some community notes mention JOIN/scale caveats requiring tuning at very large multi-node scale.
